comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-2112 rotates a hose-wand dial from Jet to Shower.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-tool counterholding under tightening reaction differs from stabilizing a wand while turning a detented selector dial.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked setting retained over three cycles; PR-2112 requires the Shower detent selected and the wand released still on the bench.
comparison.reason: Target-angle selection is shared superficially, but the hose task lacks separate locking, countertorque, and functional-cycle retention.
